## ---- 25. Comparison tables (S5, S6) and unified sensitivity tables (S9, S10) ----

## Block builder: one row per category of row_var, one column per level of
## col_var; chi-square, df and p are shown once per block. Percentages are
## column-wise.
build_comparison_block <- function(row_var, col_var, group_label) {
  tab <- table(row_var, col_var)
  test <- chisq.test(tab)
  col_totals <- colSums(tab)
  out <- tibble(Group = group_label, Category = rownames(tab))
  for (j in seq_len(ncol(tab))) {
    out[[colnames(tab)[j]]] <- sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", tab[, j], 100 * tab[, j] / col_totals[j])
  }
  out$Chi_sq  <- c(round(unname(test$statistic), 3), rep(NA_real_, nrow(out) - 1))
  out$df      <- c(unname(test$parameter),          rep(NA_integer_, nrow(out) - 1))
  out$p_value <- c(format_p(test$p.value),           rep("", nrow(out) - 1))
  out
}

## --- Predictor missingness vs. age-18 outcome (diagnostic table) ---
missingness_outcome_data <- missingness_outcome_data %>%
  mutate(
    row_cat = factor(any_predictor_missing, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE),
                      labels = c("Predictors complete", "Predictors missing")),
    col_cat = factor(jsmba6, levels = c(0, 1),
                      labels = c("No depression at 18y", "Depression at 18y"))
  )
missingness_vs_outcome_table <- build_comparison_block(missingness_outcome_data$row_cat, missingness_outcome_data$col_cat,
                              "Any predictor missing (age-15 block)")

## --- Table S6: age-15-eligible sample vs. final age-18 sample ---
## Two descriptive columns: the age-15-eligible sample and the final sample
## nested within it. Because the second is a subset of the first, chi-square, df
## and p come from the equivalent mutually exclusive split of the
## age-15-eligible sample into "reached age 18" and "lost to follow-up".
build_wave_comparison_block <- function(category, reached_final, wave1_label, wave2_label, group_label) {
  tab <- table(category, reached_final)  ## columns: FALSE (lost), TRUE (reached final wave)
  test <- chisq.test(tab)
  n_wave1 <- rowSums(tab)
  n_wave2 <- tab[, "TRUE"]
  out <- tibble(Group = group_label, Category = rownames(tab))
  out[[wave1_label]] <- sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n_wave1, 100 * n_wave1 / sum(n_wave1))
  out[[wave2_label]] <- sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n_wave2, 100 * n_wave2 / sum(n_wave2))
  out$Chi_sq  <- c(round(unname(test$statistic), 3), rep(NA_real_, nrow(out) - 1))
  out$df      <- c(unname(test$parameter),          rep(NA_integer_, nrow(out) - 1))
  out$p_value <- c(format_p(test$p.value),           rep("", nrow(out) - 1))
  out
}

eligible_15y_data <- eligible_15y_data %>%
  mutate(
    sex_lbl       = factor(asexo, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Male", "Female")),
    skin_lbl      = factor(acorpele, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4), labels = c("White", "Black", "Mixed-race", "Other")),
    drugs_lbl     = factor(drugs_pos,     levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    school_lbl    = factor(school_pos,    levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    isolation_lbl = factor(isolation_pos, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    fighting_lbl  = factor(fighting_pos,  levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    ranaway_lbl   = factor(ranaway_pos,   levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    maltreat_lbl  = factor(maltreat_cat, levels = c("None", "Probable", "Severe")),
    rel_mother_lbl  = factor(rel_mother_cat,  levels = 1:5, labels = c("Great","Very good","Good","Regular","Bad")),
    rel_father_lbl  = factor(rel_father_cat,  levels = 1:5, labels = c("Great","Very good","Good","Regular","Bad")),
    rel_between_lbl = factor(rel_between_cat, levels = 1:5, labels = c("Great","Very good","Good","Regular","Bad")),
    reached_18y = !missing_18y_outcome
  )

section_b_vars <- list(
  "Sex"                           = eligible_15y_data$sex_lbl,
  "Skin colour"                   = eligible_15y_data$skin_lbl,
  "Drug use"                      = eligible_15y_data$drugs_lbl,

  "Relationship with father"      = eligible_15y_data$rel_father_lbl,
  "Relationship between parents"  = eligible_15y_data$rel_between_lbl
)

n_wave1_total <- nrow(eligible_15y_data)
n_wave2_total <- sum(eligible_15y_data$reached_18y)
wave1_label <- sprintf("15y-eligible (N=%s)", format(n_wave1_total, big.mark = ","))
wave2_label <- sprintf("18y final sample (N=%s)", format(n_wave2_total, big.mark = ","))

table_s6_15y_to_18y <- purrr::imap_dfr(section_b_vars, ~ build_wave_comparison_block(
  .x, eligible_15y_data$reached_18y, wave1_label, wave2_label, .y
))

## --- Three mutually exclusive stages, full birth cohort (diagnostic table) ---
## Partitions the birth cohort by the last stage reached: excluded before age-15
## eligibility ("Baseline"), age-15-eligible but not in the final sample
## ("15y"), or in the final sample ("Final (18y)"). Each adolescent is in
## exactly one column, so a single chi-square test on the full R-by-3 table is
## valid.
status_data <- status_data %>%
  mutate(
    stage3 = factor(
      case_when(
        eligibility_status == "Included: valid case" ~ "Final (18y)",
        !missing_15y_data & baseline_depression == 0 & puberty_started %in% TRUE ~ "15y",
        TRUE ~ "Baseline"
      ),
      levels = c("Baseline", "15y", "Final (18y)")
    ),
    sex_lbl    = factor(asexo, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Male", "Female")),
    skin_lbl   = factor(acorpele, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4), labels = c("White", "Black", "Mixed-race", "Other")),
    educ_lbl   = factor(aescmae4cat, levels = c(0, 1, 2, 3),
                          labels = c("0 years", "1\u20134 years", "5\u20138 years", "\u22659 years")),
    income_lbl = factor(ntile(arendsm, 4), levels = 1:4,
                          labels = c("Q1 (lowest)", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4 (highest)")),
    reached_15y_eligible_lgl = as.logical(reached_15y_eligible)
  )

section_c_vars <- list(
  "Sex"                          = status_data$sex_lbl,
  "Skin colour"                  = status_data$skin_lbl,
  "Maternal education"           = status_data$educ_lbl,
  "Household income (quartiles)" = status_data$income_lbl
)

three_stage_comparison <- purrr::imap_dfr(section_c_vars, ~ build_comparison_block(.x, status_data$stage3, .y))
cat("\n--- Baseline-15y-Final 3-way comparison (diagnostic, not in manuscript) ---\n")
print(three_stage_comparison, n = Inf, width = Inf)

## --- Table S5: full birth cohort vs. age-15-eligible sample ---
## Same logic as Table S6, one step earlier: the age-15-eligible sample is a
## subset of the birth cohort, so chi-square, df and p come from the split into
## "reached age-15 eligibility" and "excluded before age 15". The variables are
## those of the Stage 1 IPW model.

n_birth_total <- nrow(status_data)
n_15y_total   <- sum(status_data$reached_15y_eligible_lgl, na.rm = TRUE)
birth_label   <- sprintf("Full birth cohort (N=%s)", format(n_birth_total, big.mark = ","))
elig15_label  <- sprintf("15y-eligible (N=%s)",       format(n_15y_total,   big.mark = ","))

table_s5_birth_to_15y <- purrr::imap_dfr(section_c_vars, ~ build_wave_comparison_block(
  .x, status_data$reached_15y_eligible_lgl, birth_label, elig15_label, .y
))

cat("\n--- Table S5 (birth cohort vs. 15y-eligible) ---\n")
print(table_s5_birth_to_15y, n = Inf, width = Inf)

## ---- Table S8, transposed (diagnostic table) ------------------------------

sensitivity_table_transposed <- sensitivity_table %>%
  mutate(across(-Scenario, as.character)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-Scenario, names_to = "Performance parameter", values_to = "value") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Scenario, values_from = value)

cat("\n--- Recoding sensitivity, transposed (diagnostic, not in manuscript) ---\n"); print(sensitivity_table_transposed, width = Inf)

## ---- Tables S9 (original model) and S10 (recalibrated model) --------------

mean_pred_recal <- function(model_data, weight_col = NULL) {
  if (is.null(weight_col)) 100 * mean(model_data$predicted_prob_recal)
  else 100 * weighted.mean(model_data$predicted_prob_recal, model_data[[weight_col]])
}

## residual_pct: the part of the prevalence rise vs. the 1993 cohort (3.1%) not
## explained by the model's risk factors (observed prevalence minus mean
## predicted risk). It is always computed from the original model: after
## recalibration, mean predicted risk equals observed prevalence by
## construction. weighted_prev_pct replaces the displayed prevalence with a
## weighted figure (IPW column only), so prevalence, mean predicted risk and
## residual share the same weighted basis.
build_perf_column <- function(boot_obj, mean_pred_pct, residual_pct, weighted_prev_pct = NULL) {
  prev_pct <- if (!is.null(weighted_prev_pct)) weighted_prev_pct else 100 * boot_obj$n_events / boot_obj$n
  c(
    N = format(boot_obj$n, big.mark = ","),
    `Depression prevalence at 18 years, n (%)` = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", boot_obj$n_events, prev_pct),
    `Mean predicted risk, %` = sprintf("%.2f%%", mean_pred_pct),
    `Residual risk not explained by model, pp` = sprintf("%.1f pp", residual_pct),
    `C-statistic (95% CI)` = fmt_ci_boot(boot_obj$c_statistic, boot_obj$c_statistic_lo, boot_obj$c_statistic_hi),
    `Mean calibration error (predicted - observed)` = fmt_ci_boot(boot_obj$mean_cal_error, boot_obj$mean_cal_error_lo, boot_obj$mean_cal_error_hi, 3),
    `Calibration-in-the-large (log-odds scale)` = fmt_ci_boot(boot_obj$citl_logodds, boot_obj$citl_logodds_lo, boot_obj$citl_logodds_hi),
    `Calibration intercept (95% CI)` = fmt_ci_boot(boot_obj$cal_intercept, boot_obj$cal_intercept_lo, boot_obj$cal_intercept_hi),
    `Calibration slope (95% CI)` = fmt_ci_boot(boot_obj$cal_slope, boot_obj$cal_slope_lo, boot_obj$cal_slope_hi),
    `O/E ratio (95% CI)` = fmt_ci_boot(boot_obj$OE_ratio, boot_obj$OE_ratio_lo, boot_obj$OE_ratio_hi),
    `Brier score` = fmt_ci_boot(boot_obj$brier, boot_obj$brier_lo, boot_obj$brier_hi, 3),
    `ICI / E-avg (mean absolute calibration error)` = fmt_ci_boot(boot_obj$ici, boot_obj$ici_lo, boot_obj$ici_hi),
    `E50 (median absolute calibration error)` = fmt_ci_boot(boot_obj$e50, boot_obj$e50_lo, boot_obj$e50_hi),
    `E90 (90th percentile absolute calibration error)` = fmt_ci_boot(boot_obj$e90, boot_obj$e90_lo, boot_obj$e90_hi),
    `Emax (max. absolute calibration error)` = fmt_ci_boot(boot_obj$emax, boot_obj$emax_lo, boot_obj$emax_hi)
  )
}

table_s9_original <- tibble(
  `Performance parameter` = names(build_perf_column(boot_main_std, gap_main$Mean_predicted_risk_pct, gap_main$Residual_pct)),
  `Main analysis` = unname(build_perf_column(boot_main_std, gap_main$Mean_predicted_risk_pct, gap_main$Residual_pct)),
  `IPW-weighted`  = unname(build_perf_column(sens1_report$boot_std, sens1_report$gap$Mean_predicted_risk_pct, sens1_report$gap$Residual_pct,
                                               weighted_prev_pct = sens1_report$gap$Observed_prevalence_pct)),
  `IQ`            = unname(build_perf_column(sens2_report$boot_std, sens2_report$gap$Mean_predicted_risk_pct, sens2_report$gap$Residual_pct)),
  `DAWBA`         = unname(build_perf_column(sens3_report$boot_std, sens3_report$gap$Mean_predicted_risk_pct, sens3_report$gap$Residual_pct)),
  `SDQ`           = unname(build_perf_column(sens4_report$boot_std, sens4_report$gap$Mean_predicted_risk_pct, sens4_report$gap$Residual_pct))
)

## Residual_pct is the same original-model value as in Table S9.
table_s10_recalibrated <- tibble(
  `Performance parameter` = names(build_perf_column(boot_main_recal, mean_pred_recal(pel_2004_model), gap_main$Residual_pct)),
  `Main analysis` = unname(build_perf_column(boot_main_recal, mean_pred_recal(pel_2004_model), gap_main$Residual_pct)),
  `IPW-weighted`  = unname(build_perf_column(sens1_report$boot_recal, mean_pred_recal(sens1_report$model_data, "stabilized_ipw"), sens1_report$gap$Residual_pct,
                                               weighted_prev_pct = sens1_report$gap$Observed_prevalence_pct)),
  `IQ`            = unname(build_perf_column(sens2_report$boot_recal, mean_pred_recal(sens2_report$model_data), sens2_report$gap$Residual_pct)),
  `DAWBA`         = unname(build_perf_column(sens3_report$boot_recal, mean_pred_recal(sens3_report$model_data), sens3_report$gap$Residual_pct)),
  `SDQ`           = unname(build_perf_column(sens4_report$boot_recal, mean_pred_recal(sens4_report$model_data), sens4_report$gap$Residual_pct))
)

cat("\n--- Table S9 (original model, unified) ---\n"); print(table_s9_original, width = Inf)
cat("\n--- Table S10 (recalibrated model, unified) ---\n"); print(table_s10_recalibrated, width = Inf)

## ---- 26. Prevalence of current MDD at age 18 (no exclusions) ------------------
## MDD = major depressive disorder. Denominator: every cohort member with an
## age-18 MINI depression result, regardless of age-15 participation or
## eligibility. Two definitions are reported: (1) MINI major depressive episode
## as scored, in which manic/hypomanic cases are not removed; (2) the
## main-analysis definition, in which adolescents with a lifetime
## manic/hypomanic episode are non-cases (Section 8). Definition (2) is the
## like-for-like comparator for the analytic sample.
full_18y <- status_data %>% filter(!is.na(jsmba6))
prev_ci_text <- function(k, n) {
  ci <- binom.test(k, n)$conf.int          # exact (Clopper-Pearson) interval
  sprintf("%d/%d = %.1f%% (95%% CI %.1f to %.1f)", k, n, 100 * k / n, 100 * ci[1], 100 * ci[2])
}
stopifnot(!anyNA(full_18y$ever_manic_hypomanic))   # mania screen available for everyone with an age-18 MINI
prevalence_full_cohort <- tibble(
  Definition = c("MINI MDE as scored (manic/hypomanic cases NOT removed)",
                 "Main-analysis definition (lifetime manic/hypomanic recoded as non-case)",
                 "Memo: analytic sample, main-analysis definition"),
  `n / N (%, 95% CI)` = c(
    prev_ci_text(sum(full_18y$jsmba6 == 1), nrow(full_18y)),
    prev_ci_text(sum(ifelse(full_18y$ever_manic_hypomanic, 0, full_18y$jsmba6)), nrow(full_18y)),
    prev_ci_text(n_events, n_analytic)
  )
)
cat(sprintf("\n--- Prevalence of current MDD at 18y, all %d adolescents with an 18y MINI result (no exclusions) ---\n", nrow(full_18y)))
cat(sprintf("Lifetime manic/hypomanic episode: %d (of whom %d met MINI MDE criteria)\n",
            sum(full_18y$ever_manic_hypomanic), sum(full_18y$ever_manic_hypomanic & full_18y$jsmba6 == 1)))
print(prevalence_full_cohort, width = Inf)

## ---- 28. Sensitivity calibration plots (Figures S2-S5) ----------------------
## Each scenario's original and recalibrated plots side by side (patchwork); all
## five scenarios are then stacked into one overview figure.

make_row <- function(cal_std, cal_recal, scenario_label) {
  p_std   <- cal_std   + labs(title = paste0(scenario_label, " \u2014 Original model"))
  p_recal <- cal_recal + labs(title = "Recalibrated model")
  p_std + p_recal
}

row_main  <- make_row(cal_standard_plot, cal_recal_plot, "Main analysis")

row_sens3 <- make_row(sens3_report$cal_std, sens3_report$cal_recal, "DAWBA 11y/15y exclusion")
row_sens4 <- make_row(sens4_report$cal_std, sens4_report$cal_recal, "SDQ 11y/15y exclusion")

ggsave("results/figure_s3_calibration_iq.png", row_sens2, width = 12, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)
ggsave("results/figure_s4_calibration_dawba.png", row_sens3, width = 12, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)
